h:
如果您厌倦了处理缺失的自定义节点、红框和复杂的 LoRA 堆栈，那么此工作流程适合您。该工作流程严格采用 100% 原生 ComfyUI 节点设计，保证开箱即用的流畅“即插即用”体验。

主要特点

零自定义节点：无需安装额外的扩展或排除依赖错误。它就是有效的。

双LoRA链：两个LoRA按顺序连接。您可以原生获得多 LoRA 支持，无需安装任何复杂的“LoRA Stack”节点。

针对 FLUX.2 [Klein] (9B) 进行了优化：经过完美调整，以获得 Klein 模型的最佳性能和质量。

适合初学者的布局：干净、有组织且非常容易理解。

o.en:
If you are tired of dealing with missing custom nodes, red boxes, and complicated LoRA stacks, this workflow is for you. Designed strictly with 100% Native ComfyUI Nodes, this workflow guarantees a smooth "plug-and-play" experience right out of the box.

Key Features

Zero Custom Nodes: No need to install extra extensions or troubleshoot dependency errors. It just works.

Dual LoRA Chain: Two LoRAs are concatenated sequentially. You get multi-LoRA support natively, without installing any complex "LoRA Stack" nodes.

Optimized for FLUX.2 [Klein] (9B): Perfectly tuned to get the best performance and quality out of the Klein model.

Beginner-Friendly Layout: Clean, organized, and extremely easy to understand.
